parameters.name: BSSID
parameters.description: The MAC Address of the logical BSS (BSSID). If the instance of this {{object}} is the same as {{object|Device.WiFi.SSID.{i}.}}, then this parameter is the same as {{param|Device.WiFi.SSID.{i}.BSSID}}.

parameters.name: SSID
parameters.description: The SSID in use for this BSS. If the instance of this {{object}} is the same as {{object|Device.WiFi.SSID.{i}.}}, then this parameter is the same as {{param|Device.WiFi.SSID.{i}.SSID}}.

parameters.name: Enabled
parameters.description: Whether the BSSID is currently enabled (beaconing frames are being sent) or disabled. If the instance of this {{object}} is the same as {{object|Device.WiFi.SSID.{i}.}}, then this parameter is the same as {{param|Device.WiFi.SSID.{i}.Enable}}.

parameters.name: LastChange
parameters.description: Time in {{units}} since the last change to the {{param|Enabled}} value. If the instance of this {{object}} is the same as {{object|Device.WiFi.SSID.{i}.}}, then this parameter is the same as {{param|Device.WiFi.SSID.{i}.LastChange}}.

parameters.name: TimeStamp
parameters.description: The time this group was collected. Formatted with the date-and-time string format as defined in {{bibref|RFC3339|Section 3}}.

parameters.name: UnicastBytesSent
parameters.description: Access Point (BSS) wide statistics for total unicast bytes transmitted. This counter does not include Multi-Link Device (MLD) traffic through this BSS.

parameters.name: UnicastBytesReceived
parameters.description: Access Point (BSS) wide statistics for total unicast bytes received. This counter does not include MLD traffic through this BSS.

parameters.name: MulticastBytesSent
parameters.description: Access Point (BSS) wide statistics for total multicast bytes transmitted. This counter does not include MLD traffic through this BSS.

parameters.name: MulticastBytesReceived
parameters.description: Access Point (BSS) wide statistics for total multicast bytes received. This counter does not include MLD traffic through this BSS.

parameters.name: BroadcastBytesSent
parameters.description: Access Point (BSS) wide statistics for total broadcast bytes transmitted. This counter does not include MLD traffic through this BSS.

parameters.name: BroadcastBytesReceived
parameters.description: Access Point (BSS) wide statistics for total broadcast bytes received. This counter does not include MLD traffic through this BSS.

parameters.name: ByteCounterUnits
parameters.description: Byte Counter Units. : 1: kibibytes (KiB) : 2: mebibytes (MiB).

parameters.name: Profile1bSTAsDisallowed
parameters.description: Profile-1 Backhaul STA association disallowed. : {{true}}: Backhaul STA association disallowed; : {{false}}: Backhaul STA association allowed.

parameters.name: Profile2bSTAsDisallowed
parameters.description: Profile-2 Backhaul STA association disallowed. : {{true}}: Profile 2 bSTA disallowed; : {{false}}: Profile 2 bSTA allowed.

parameters.name: AssociationAllowanceStatus
parameters.description: The status of allowance of new client device associations on this BSS. : 0: No more associations allowed, : 1: Associations allowed.

parameters.name: EstServiceParametersBE
parameters.description: Estimated Service Parameters information field for AC=BE, defined per {{bibref|802.11-2020|Figure 9-637}} and referenced in {{bibref|EasyMesh|Section 17.2.22}}.

parameters.name: EstServiceParametersBK
parameters.description: Estimated Service Parameters information field for AC=BK, defined per {{bibref|802.11-2020|Figure 9-637}} and referenced in {{bibref|EasyMesh|Section 17.2.22}}.

parameters.name: EstServiceParametersVI
parameters.description: Estimated Service Parameters information field for AC=VI, defined per {{bibref|802.11-2020|Figure 9-637}} and referenced in {{bibref|EasyMesh|Section 17.2.22}}.

parameters.name: EstServiceParametersVO
parameters.description: Estimated Service Parameters information field for AC=VO, defined per {{bibref|802.11-2020|Figure 9-637}} and referenced in {{bibref|EasyMesh|Section 17.2.22}}.

parameters.name: BackhaulUse
parameters.description: Indicates that this BSS is in use as a backhaul BSS; : {{true}}: backhaul BSS in use, : {{false}}: backhaul BSS not in use. In {{bibref|EasyMesh}} 0 is in use and 1 is not in use.

parameters.name: FronthaulUse
parameters.description: Indicates that this BSS is in use as a fronthaul BSS; : {{true}}: fronthaul BSS in use, : {{false}}: fronthaul BSS not in use. In {{bibref|EasyMesh}} 0 is in use and 1 is not in use.

parameters.name: R1disallowed
parameters.description: Multi-AP Profile-1 [3] (R1) disallowed status. : {{true}}: disallowed, : {{false}}: allowed. In {{bibref|EasyMesh}} 0 is allowed and 1 is disallowed.

parameters.name: R2disallowed
parameters.description: Multi-AP Profile-2 [3] (R2) disallowed status. : {{true}}: disallowed, : {{false}}: allowed. In {{bibref|EasyMesh}} 0 is allowed and 1 is disallowed.

parameters.name: MultiBSSID
parameters.description: Multiple BSSID Set; : {{true}}: configured, : {{false}}: not-configured. In {{bibref|EasyMesh}}, 1 is configured and 0 is not-configured.

parameters.name: TransmittedBSSID
parameters.description: Transmitted BSSID; : {{true}}: transmitted, : {{false}}: non-transmitted. In {{bibref|EasyMesh}}, 1 is transmitted and 0 is non-transmitted.

parameters.name: FronthaulAKMsAllowed
parameters.description: {{list}} List items indicate Authentication and Key Management (AKM) suites/security modes allowed at this BSS for fronthaul. {{enum}}

parameters.name: FronthaulSuiteSelector
parameters.description: AKM suite selector, the AKM suite selector (OUI and type) is encoded as a 4-octet hex-encoded value without internal delimiters, e.g. 506F9A02 {{bibref|802.11-2020|Table 9-151}}. This parameter applies if {{param|FronthaulAKMsAllowed}} includes value "SuiteSelector".

parameters.name: BackhaulAKMsAllowed
parameters.description: {{list}} List items indicate Authentication and Key Management (AKM) suites/security modes allowed at this BSS for backhaul. {{enum}}

parameters.name: BackhaulSuiteSelector
parameters.description: AKM suite selector, the AKM suite selector (OUI and type) is encoded as a 4-octet hex-encoded value without internal delimiters, e.g. 506F9A02 {{bibref|802.11-2020|Table 9-151}}. This parameter applies if {{param|BackhaulAKMsAllowed}} includes value "SuiteSelector".

parameters.name: BasicDataTransmitRates
parameters.description: {{list}} The current basic data rates; the set of data rates, in {{units}}, that have to be supported by all stations that desire to join this BSS. The stations have to be able to receive and transmit at each of the data rates listed in {{param}}. Most control packets use a data rate in {{param}}.

parameters.name: STANumberOfEntries
parameters.description: {{numentries}}

parameters.name: QMDescriptorNumberOfEntries
parameters.description: {{numentries}}

object.description: A single logical BSS operating on this radio.
